# Badge

> Compact status, label, or count chip.

This file matches the installed `badge` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/badge.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/badge.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/badge-knobs`: `badgeKnobs`, types `BadgeKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/badge`: `badgeVariants`, `badgeSizes`, `BADGE_COLORS`, `Badge`, types `BadgeVariant`, `BadgeSize`, `BadgeColor`, `BadgeProps`

## Composition

### Status or label

```tsx
<Badge />
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { Check } from "lucide-react";
import type { BadgeColor } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/badge";
import { Badge } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/badge";

const badgeColors: BadgeColor[] = ["neutral", "red", "orange", "yellow", "green", "blue", "purple", "pink"];

export function PrimitiveBadgeExample() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      <Badge>Default</Badge>
      <Badge size="sm">Small</Badge>
      <Badge color="blue">Beta</Badge>
      <Badge color="yellow">15</Badge>
      <Badge color="red">Denied</Badge>
      <Badge color="primary" size="sm">
        3
      </Badge>
      <Badge color="primary" variant="outline">
        Primary
      </Badge>
      <Badge variant="outline">Outline</Badge>
      <Badge render={<button type="button" />} variant="ghost">
        Ghost
      </Badge>
      <Badge color="green">
        <Check />
        Allowed
      </Badge>
      {badgeColors.map((color) => (
        <Badge color={color} key={color}>
          {color}
        </Badge>
      ))}
      <Badge render={<a href="#docs" />}>Link badge</Badge>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `badge`
  - `root`: `data-color` (any value), `data-size` (`md` | `sm`), `data-variant` (`default` | `ghost` | `outline`)

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### badge

- `--cui-badge-icon`: `1em`
- `--cui-badge-radius`: `var(--nest-radius, var(--radius-control))`
- `--cui-badge-background`: `var(--_badge-color-background)`
- `--cui-badge-foreground`: `var(--_badge-color-foreground)`
- `--cui-badge-border-color`: `transparent`
- `--cui-badge-border-width`: `1px`
- `--cui-badge-font-family`: `var(--font-body)`
- `--cui-badge-font-size`: `var(--text-caption)`
- `--cui-badge-font-weight`: `var(--font-weight-medium)`
